description.zh:
用户身份识别ID，支持英文大写字母和数字。

建议您设置为该用户的身份证号、学号等。
description.en:
The user identity ID. The value can contain uppercase letters and digits.

We recommend that you set this parameter to the ID card number or student ID of the user.

description.zh: 用户的人脸图片URL下载地址，目前仅支持JPEG和JPG格式的图片，且图片URL不能包含中文。
description.en: The URL of the user's face image. Currently, only images in JPEG and JPG formats are supported, and the image URL cannot contain Chinese characters.

description.zh:
业务隔离ID，用于同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据隔离，支持英文大小写字母、数字。

例如，您在A地区和B地区，均有人脸识别业务，那么可设置不同的业务隔离ID，区分A、B地区的人脸识别业务。

><notice>
请妥善保存业务隔离ID值，以便后续调用此业务隔离区其它接口时使用。
></notice>
description.en:
The business isolation ID, which is used for data isolation between different business applications under the same Alibaba Cloud account. The value can contain uppercase and lowercase letters and digits.

For example, if you have facial recognition services in both Region A and Region B, you can set different business isolation IDs to distinguish the facial recognition services in Region A and Region B.

><notice>
Properly save the business isolation ID value for subsequent calls to other operations in this business isolation zone.
></notice>

description.zh: 用户名。支持中文、英文字母大小写、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度不超过64个字符。
description.en: The username. The value can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

title.zh: 向人脸管理服务添加一个用户
title.en: Add a user to the face management service

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明

- 单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为100。

    > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。

- 请提前为用户的人脸图片，配置URL下载地址。

    > 当前仅支持JPEG和JPG格式的图片，且图片URL中不能包含中文。

- 调用该接口后，系统会返回用户ID（**UserId**），建议保存该值到本地，以便后续调用其它接口时使用。
descriptions.en:
## Usage notes

- The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this operation is 100.

    > RAM users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

- Configure a URL download address for the user's face image in advance.

    > Currently, only images in JPEG and JPG formats are supported, and the image URL cannot contain Chinese characters.

- After you call this operation, the system returns a user ID (**UserId**). We recommend that you save this value locally for subsequent calls to other operations.
